name: DataCore ETL — Ingest to MongoDB
description: High-level view of the DataCore ETL pipeline: four discovery sources publish to Kafka, DataCore consumes and runs its internal modules (mapping, recognition, reconciliation-rules, reconciliation/dedup), then writes the golden record to Cassandra + raw payload to S3 before normalization reaches MongoDB. The dashed Legacy Pipeline arc is a historical direct path that bypasses the ETL entirely.

annotations.text: Acquired 2025 — passive network discovery and application dependency mapping (repos: sensor, lumen-cyclops). Onboarded as a discovery source alongside OnPrem/Classic and VNext.

LECDataCore monorepo — consumes inbound Kafka events and runs the mapping/recognition/reconciliation pipeline before emitting the golden record. See LECDataCore/docs/MONOREPO.md for the module breakdown used in this diagram.
Module `mapping` — transforms raw input from different systems (classic/LSHub/vNext) into a standardized internal model. LECDataCore/libs/mapping.
Proto com.lansweeper.dp.fingerprints.v1.DevRecogInputDevice — raw fingerprint payload consumed by the recognition module.

Module `recognition` — three separate normalization contexts confirmed in code: EtlContext.RECOG_CONTEXT_KEY (device), SOFTWARE_NORMALIZATION_KEY, MONITOR_NORMALIZATION_KEY. LECDataCore/libs/mapping-util/.../EtlContext.java.

Module `reconciliation-rules` — ReconciliationRuleMerger combines default + site-custom rules (DefaultReconRuleSetProvider), prioritizing customized rules over defaults. LECDataCore/libs/reconciliation-rules.
Module `reconciliation` — ReactiveFindOperator locates candidate matches using the active ReconRuleSet (MAC, IP, IMEI, AD SID/UPN, ...).
Module `reconciliation` — MergeOperator + master builders construct the reconciled 'golden' record from matched duplicates; post-processors run after.

nodes.text: Legacy Pipeline = simplification. The real classic/vNext path to Mongo hops through Adapter + Asset Consumer (see asset-data-path-classic / asset-data-path-discovery flows) — this arc collapses that into one edge for the high-level view Boss sketched.
